name: iCCI iMA
summary: This EA combines the Commodity Channel Index (CCI) and Moving Average (iMA) indicators to generate trade signals. It opens buy positions when CCI crosses below a threshold and price is above the MA, and sell positions when CCI crosses above a threshold and price is below the MA. The strategy targets momentum reversals confirmed by trend direction from the moving average.
summary_zh: 该EA结合商品通道指标(CCI)和移动平均线(iMA)生成交易信号。当CCI下穿阈值且价格在MA上方时开多仓，当CCI上穿阈值且价格在MA下方时开空仓。策略针对由移动平均线确认趋势方向的动量反转。
strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是利用CCI指标识别动量超买超卖区域，同时用移动平均线判断主趋势方向，仅在趋势方向一致时入场。入场条件为：做多时要求CCI从超卖区上穿且价格位于MA之上，做空时要求CCI从超买区下穿且价格位于MA之下。出场条件依赖于固定止盈止损或反向信号触发平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户资金动态调整。资金管理方面缺乏风险比例控制，每笔交易使用相同手数而不考虑波动率或账户余额变化。整体策略逻辑简单清晰，但缺少对市场环境变化的适应性。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy uses the CCI indicator to identify momentum overbought and oversold zones, while the moving average determines the main trend direction, entering trades only when the trend direction aligns. Entry conditions: for buy signals, CCI crosses up from oversold territory while price is above the MA; for sell signals, CCI crosses down from overbought territory while price is below the MA. Exit conditions rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or reverse signal triggers to close positions. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity. Money management lacks risk-proportion control, using the same lot size per trade regardless of volatility or account balance changes. The overall strategy logic is simple and clear but lacks adaptability to changing market conditions.
pros: 策略逻辑简单明了，易于理解和维护
双指标过滤减少了假信号，CCI配合趋势方向提高胜率
参数可调性强，用户可根据不同品种和市场环境优化
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and maintain
Dual indicator filtering reduces false signals; CCI combined with trend direction improves win rate
High parameter adjustability allows users to optimize for different instruments and market conditions
cons: 固定手数仓位管理，未根据账户风险动态调整
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
止盈止损默认为零，存在不设止损直接交易的严重风险
cons_en: Fixed lot position sizing without dynamic adjustment based on account risk
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening repeated positions on the same bar
Stop-loss and take-profit default to zero, posing serious risk of trading without protection
improvements: 增加基于账户余额百分比或ATR的动态仓位管理
添加新K线检测逻辑防止同根K线重复交易
设置合理的默认止盈止损值并增加点差过滤
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage or ATR
Add new bar detection logic to prevent repeated trades on the same bar
Set reasonable default stop-loss and take-profit values and add spread filter

risk_points: 默认止盈止损为零，可能导致无限亏损
缺少新K线检查，存在同根K线重复开仓风险
固定手数不考虑账户资金变化，大亏损后仍按原手数交易
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, potentially leading to unlimited losses
Lacks new bar check, risking repeated position opening on the same bar
Fixed lot size ignores account equity changes, continuing same size after large losses

The strategy targets momentum reversals confirmed by trend direction from the moving average.
